name: Small-scale tool use eval v1
description: Runs all 100 items of eval-tools-small-v1 at temperature 0: one or two tools per request, derived arguments (relative dates, spoken times, units), a choice between near-identical tools, asking instead of guessing, a second call that uses the first call's result, answering from a tool result, and revising a call after the user changes one detail. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: Send meta.tools as the request's tools parameter with tool_choice='auto' and score tool_calls[0], as for eval-tools-v1. Multi-turn rows carry earlier assistant tool_calls and tool results in messages. clarify and use_result rows are correct only when no call is made; use_result additionally requires the reply to contain answer.reply_contains.

notes: Part of the small-model tier (workloads/README.md). Engines differ in how they emit tool calls (native field vs a parsed text block): record the tool-call parser flag in the result's args, because it changes the score. accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`.
